brief: Separate confirmed resources from uncertain income and revise optional spending when an expected receipt does not arrive.

en-US.scenario: Fictional US-dollar examples for "Income can change"; illustrative amounts, not current prices or product offers. No assumption of salary, bank ownership or spare income.

es-MX.scenario: Ejemplos ficticios en pesos mexicanos para "El ingreso puede cambiar"; montos ilustrativos, no precios vigentes ni ofertas. No se supone nómina, cuenta bancaria ni dinero sobrante.

pt-BR.scenario: Exemplos fictícios em reais para "A renda pode mudar"; valores ilustrativos, não preços atuais nem ofertas. Sem supor salário, conta bancária ou dinheiro sobrando.

objective.observable_action: Separate confirmed resources from uncertain income and revise optional spending when an expected receipt does not arrive.
objective.success_criterion: Complete the fresh-context transfer using only its visible information.

instruction.relevance: A useful plan still works when a hoped-for payment is late. Separate what is confirmed from what might arrive.
instruction.misconception: Treating an unusually good month or an unconfirmed job as a guaranteed baseline.
instruction.numeracy_support: Use comparisons and subtraction already demonstrated; uncertainty is described explicitly.

evidence.reasoning: Ana has 100 available; a possible repair could bring 50. The repair is unconfirmed, so only 100 is available.
Necessary payments use 80, leaving 20. She can revise the plan if the extra payment actually arrives.
The possible repair has not produced a received payment.
The optional purchase depended on money that did not arrive.
One unusually strong month does not establish a guaranteed monthly amount.
The note distinguishes uncertainty from confirmed resources.
Revising an optional future commitment responds to the changed resources.
A canceled unpaid sale does not fund the purchase.

delayed_retrieval.fresh_context: Apply this skill in a later integrated decision with a different constraint.
